name: WorldScore
summary: 根据指定相机轨迹连续生成场景，评测可控性、三维一致性与动态表现。
summaryEn: Evaluates sequential world generation under camera trajectories for controllability, 3D consistency and dynamics.
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 相机控制和场景一致性不等于物体动力学或机器人动作响应。
wmNoteEn: Camera control and scene consistency are not equivalent to object dynamics or robot motor response.

evidence.statement: World generation is decomposed into sequential next-scene tasks with explicit camera trajectories. The benchmark evaluates camera adherence, geometry consistency and specified motion across generated sequences.
